en.headline: Hong Kong China International Tattoo Exhibition runs through Sunday at SoHo House
en.dek: More than 60 local and international artists are showing work at the three-day event in Sheung Wan, which includes an AI try-on system and a competition on the final day.
body: The Hong Kong China International Tattoo Exhibition 2026 is under way at SoHo House in Sheung Wan from 16 to 18 October, with sessions from 10am to 10pm.

Organisers said more than 60 tattoo artists from Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, Europe and elsewhere are participating. The event is co-presented with Freedom Tattoo HK and includes live demonstrations, music performances and a tattoo competition on Sunday afternoon.

A local company, Oh My Ink, is demonstrating an AI-powered try-on system that lets visitors preview designs on their own bodies in real time by adjusting size and placement. Regular one-day tickets are priced at HK$200 and a three-day pass at HK$300.
The exhibition takes place on the second and third floors of SoHo House at 33 Des Voeux Road West, a short walk from Sheung Wan or Sai Ying Pun MTR stations.

zh.headline: 香港中國國際紋身展2026於上環SoHo House舉行至周日
zh.dek: 超過60位本地及國際紋身師參展，設AI試紋身系統，周日有比賽，門票由200元起。
body: 香港中國國際紋身展2026由10月16日至18日在上環SoHo House舉行，每日上午10時至晚上10時開放。
主辦方表示有超過60位來自香港、日本、韓國、歐洲等地的紋身師參展。活動由Freedom Tattoo HK共同呈獻，包括即場示範、音樂表演，周日下午設紋身比賽。
本地公司Oh My Ink展出AI試紋身系統，讓參觀者即時在自己身上預覽設計，並可調整大小及位置。單日門票200元，三日票300元。
展覽位於德輔道西33號SoHo House二至三樓，可從上環或西營盤港鐵站步行前往。
